assumptions.basis: Conservative planning rate: early-October-2026 market quotes were roughly 1.43-1.45 AUD per USD (e.g. exchange-rates.org AUD/USD history for 2026-10-01 ~0.693); 1.50 is deliberately higher so AUD figures overstate rather than understate spend. Override via AGENT_READINESS_USD_TO_AUD or the ledger file; re-check against an official rate before reporting a final figure.
